verdict.rationale: Agent-readable docs are a fair axis for a SaaS monitoring platform like Raygun, but the probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404), and no evidence item describes agent-oriented documentation. The official MCP server belongs to a separate story and does not count as agent-oriented docs, and the AI error-resolution chat is an in-product feature, not documentation an agent can consume.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
